description: This file defines an interface 'SearchSessionFactory' for creating instances of 'SearchSession' within the OpenMRS project, particularly in the context of Hibernate Search integration. It includes documentation and licensing details.

classes.name: SearchSessionFactory
classes.description: An interface for factory objects that produce 'SearchSession' instances, used within OpenMRS for search functionalities.

methods.name: getSearchSession
methods.description: Returns an instance of 'SearchSession' that can be used for Hibernate Search operations.
